title: A harness without an anchor point is worth nothing
lines: A good harness is the beginning, not the end.
Without a strong anchor point, the harness won't stop a fall.
Clip in before climbing, and unclip only once you're standing on the ground.
Check the gear before every job, and the slightest tear means it's out.
Need professional gear? We have it all, with free advice.
